name: Los Angeles Zoo Core Volunteer (students 14 and up)
what_you_do: Core volunteers help zoo guests and support the Zoo's guest engagement programs.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be at least 14 years old and able to finish the required training. No upper age limit is stated.
duration: 25 hours per year for students (50 hours per year for other volunteers)
deadline_text: Applications are closed now. The Zoo has a waitlist to tell you when they open. No dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Join the waitlist on the Zoo's volunteer page. When applications open, go to an info meeting and an interview. You are invited to these. Then finish online and in-person training. You must also pass a fingerprint background check.
notes: Applications were closed when this page was read. A negative tuberculosis test may be needed for some advanced roles. Phone: (323) 644-4200.
